name: SAHE Main Gate & Entrance Arch
description: Architectural maroon entrance arch with bold Siddhartha Academy signage along Vijayawada NH65 Bandar Road.

name: SAHE Cricket Ground & Athletic Oval
description: Full-size athletic ground with 400m running track, turf pitch, practice nets, and spectator pavilion.

name: VRSEC Synthetic Basketball Court
description: Floodlit acrylic synthetic surface basketball court hosting inter-collegiate championships.

name: Saraswathi Statue & KachhaPi Garden Circle
description: Iconic landscaped garden rotunda featuring the Goddess Saraswathi sculpture and KachhaPi musical water monument.

name: Swami Vivekananda / Ramakrishna Statue
description: Centrally positioned commemorative statue honoring Swami Vivekananda on the primary campus promenade.

name: Dr. V L Dutt Courtyard Statue
description: Founders commemorative statue honoring Dr. V L Dutt situated within the CSE courtyard garden.

name: Canara Bank & 24/7 ATM Branch
description: Full-service banking branch and cash automated teller machine near the athletic ground pavilion.

name: Tata Power EV Fast Charging Station
description: 60kW dual-gun CCS2 electric vehicle DC fast charger accessible from the main entrance avenue.

name: Pranayuv Technologies Incubation Wing
description: Campus technology incubator and industry collaboration center.

name: Pragathi Residency Hostel
description: Affiliated student boarding residence along Tummala Venkata Subbarao Street.
